title: Team Lead – Customer Care
description:
**Company:** 
 INDmoney
 



**Location:** 
 GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 



  





**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office \| 6 days/week (rotational week off between Saturday and Sunday)
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Team Lead – Customer Care to lead a team of customer support executives, ensure high service quality, and drive resolution efficiency across voice, chat, and email channels. This is an ownership\-driven operations role suited for someone with strong leadership instincts and a passion for customer experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of customer care executives handling user queries across calls, chat, and email
* Monitor daily team performance against KPIs — TAT, CSAT, first\-call resolution, AHT, and escalation rates
* Handle escalated or complex customer issues requiring senior intervention
* Prepare and present performance reports/dashboards to management on a daily/weekly/monthly basis
* Identify recurring customer pain points and work with product/ops teams to drive process improvements
* Drive training and onboarding for new team members
* Ensure adherence to compliance, data security, and regulatory requirements (especially relevant for financial services)
* Foster a positive, high\-performance team culture



  





 Work Schedule
 


* 6 days working from office (GIFT City, Gandhinagar)
* Week off is rotational between Saturday and Sunday — candidates should be comfortable working on weekends as per roster



  





 Requirements
 


* 4–7 years of experience in customer service/support, with at least 1–2 years in a team lead or supervisory role
* Prior experience in BFSI, fintech, or a related regulated industry preferred
* Strong communication skills
* Proven ability to manage and motivate a team in a fast\-paced environment
* Data\-driven approach with hands\-on experience using CRM/helpdesk tools (Freshdesk, Zendesk, etc.) and MIS/reporting
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to handle escalations calmly and effectively
* Graduate degree in any discipline; MBA preferred but not mandatory
* Willingness to work 6 days a week from office, with rotational weekend offs, and in shifts as required

title: Lead Project Quality Manager
description:
The Project Quality Manager has independence and authority to manage quality and nuclear safety across the project and is the key quality interface with the Customer, manages the quality and nuclear safety activities across the entire execution chain of an integrated project.
   

  

 Project Quality manager will integral part of the project team and ensures that all quality and nuclear safety related requirements in the contract is fulfilled.
   

  

* Ensure alignment within the project framework on all customers contracted quality expectations.
* Define and implement a strategy, priorities, and an action plan to drive nuclear safety across the project. It needs to be in line with the organization’s overall strategy and priorities.
* Ensure that the nuclear safety culture is deployed within the project, support its assessment and training campaigns and / or any event to promote nuclear safety (e.g., nuclear safety moments).
* Ensure that ITNS\-item information and data are rigorously communicated into our internal documentation (e.g., ITPL etc.).
* Contribute to quotation / negotiation from a Quality and Nuclear Safety perspective (ITO)
* Analyze the project contractual requirements and translate them into a comprehensive project quality strategy via the PMF (Project Management File) and quality plans.
* Ensure project Quality induction to the entire project team.
* Chair the project quality kick off meeting to share issued Quality plans with the Customer for validation.
* Accountability for the ITPs (Inspection and Test Programs) and ensuring compliance with contract / customer expectations.
* Prepare and drive regular Project Quality Review (internal), Quality KPI of the Project (part of the bowler chart) and to report them to the Project Director and Quality Management.
* Represent Quality within the Project reviews with the Customer (external) and share remedy plans, as necessary.
* Establish surveillance strategy (e.g., training, audit), based on project risk assessment.
* Define and deploy appropriate governance with relevant project stakeholders to regularly follow\-up of project tracking.
* Coordinate resolution of complex Quality issues raised along project execution.
* Ensure plans are in place to demonstrate conformance to Technical Regulation and Standards (TRS), local regulation, and requirements (PED etc.). Follow\-up Product PQMs (internal manufacturing), Supplier Quality (external supply) during manufacturing phase and Site Quality Management during site execution.
* EOMR compilation and follow\-up to the Customer in a timely manner (in line with master time schedule)
* Coordinate preparation and ensure flawless execution of the Customer audits.
* Guide, train, support, and coach the Project team for using relevant quality tools.
* Support Project Management within the PEQ (Project Execution Quality) process.
* Support Project Management within the Customer Satisfaction process.
* Ensure the Non\-Conformance Report (NCR) governance and interface with customers.
* Ensures overall governance of Customer Inspections (notification, attendance, reporting, action tracking)

title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer - Assembly Process
description:
Establish the detailed manufacturing processes of the job utilizing own experience and coordination with lead factories for implementing their best processes and practices. Drive the culture of continuous improvements and take lean initiatives.
   

  

 Demonstrates accountability of Engineer for functional, business, and broad company objectives. Integrates and develops processes that meet business needs across the organization. Defined work or projects with moderate complexity. In this role you will follow an individual work plan and meet day\-to\-day short term objectives, and have the ability to resolve issues through immediate action or short\-term and Long term planning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Prepare, develop, and generate all manufacturing documentation including, but not limited to process planning, method specification, process specification, repair instruction, drawing.
* Provide technical advice, engineering evaluation, and disposition to repair process and operation, including process troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
* Provide Qualification for Component Process
* Prepare new repair process development, start\-up, training, and implementation. Coordinate with a team for installation, start\-up, and commissioning of new equipment.
* Prepare and perform operator qualification and special process qualification, including Repair Process Plan, Engineering documentation \& operator training.
* Coordinate with a team of individual contributors by establishing appropriate work plans and priorities consistent with engineering goals.
* Work with management to assign, perform, oversee, and schedule work tasks and meet cost objectives.
* Assist in the effective utilization of available manpower and machine resources for all repair, overhaul, and servicing jobs in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Assist in future plans and contriving new product / services introduction (NPI) Act as liaison with Repair Technology CoE to develop and implement new repair processes.
* Handle all customer complaints and recommend / perform resolutions as appropriate. Liaise with other department engineers for support / re\-deployment of manpower and machine resources for internal sub\-contract work
* Develop the best manufacturing practice in accordance with the customer CTQs Participate on Global Component Teams to drive productivity / standardization.
* Drive continuous process improvement through LEAN \- Six Sigma.
* Participate on Environment Health \& Safety Compliance
* Conduct Internal Audit according to ISO: 9001
* Accept other assignment based on Company Requirement
* Work on cycle time and cost reduction program for all kinds of repair work including in\-house and on\-site work.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* EHS and Lean
* On Time Delivery
* COPQ (Cost of Poor Quality) control
* New product qualification
* Root cause analysis \& Risk assessment
* Process improvement


**Desired Skill Set**
* Excellent process engineering capabilities and analytical skills.
* Thorough knowledge of heavy machining and assembly processes, Know how of steam turbine is beneficial.
* Key Assembly \& Testing process – ITB Blading , RTB Blading (OEM \& OOEM Design) for Rotor as well as Stationary Parts i.e Blade carrier , Inner Casing Diaphragm etc , Module Assembly for HP, IP \& LP Module , Small IST Turbine , Nuclear HIP Turbine , Valve Assembly , Bearing Pedestal Assembly, Hydraulic Test of the Casing ,Valve \& Bearing Pedestal
* Key Machining Processes – Milling , Turning of Shroud , Basic Knowledge of NC Programming \& Job Set up on Machine
* Key Blade Manufacturing Process – Blade Machining on 5 Axis Machine and 3 Axis Machine ; Understanding of Blade Drawings and KODATA File \& Final Polishing Process of Blades
* Thorough understanding of Engineering Drawings, Standards and Specifications
* Strong EHS \& quality focus
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to identify and implement cost reduction strategies based upon process improvements and experience.
* Ability to develop credibility with employees, manager, and peers
* High attention to detail and accuracy of every task and Anticipate the future risks or challenges in advance
* Vendor development skills for new products and processes.
* Demonstrated integrity – accept and adhere to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, and actions when dealing with others
* Resolves internal issues quickly to meet customer expectations
* Come up with the alternative approach while raising a problem or a challenge
* Able to work cross functional teams to generate customer solutions as the final goal


**Required Qualifications**
* BE/BTech/Diploma in Mechanical /Production min 8 years of relevant experience – min 5\-yearcore experience of process/method of heavy machining and assembly

title: Director, Information Technology
description:
**About Analog Devices**
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

**Director, Information Technology**
**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The
 **Director, Information Technology** 
 will provide strategic and operational leadership for ADI's IT organization in India, driving technology strategy, business partnership, delivery excellence, and organizational development. The role will lead a portfolio of enterprise applications with a primary focus on supporting ADI's global Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations functions.
   

  

 Working closely with business leaders, executive stakeholders, and global IT teams, the Director will lead strategic initiatives, application modernization, operational improvements, and AI\-enabled digital transformation efforts that support business growth and operational excellence.
   

  

 The Director will report to the Sr. Director, IT (India) and work closely with global IT and business leadership teams.
   

  

**Leadership Profile**
 The successful candidate will be a people\-first leader with exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills. They will have a proven track record of building and developing high\-performing teams across multiple locations, cultures, and time zones while effectively navigating both solid\-line and matrixed reporting structures.
   

  

 Through strong collaboration, influence, and relationship\-building capabilities, this leader will foster alignment across business and IT organizations, drive accountability, and deliver results in a complex global environment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader with strong business acumen, capable of delivering results through influence, developing future leaders, and fostering strong partnerships across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and IT.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership \& Business Partnership**
* Partner with business and IT leaders to define and execute technology strategies supporting business priorities and enterprise IT initiatives.
* Drive portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and execution of strategic programs.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders and identify opportunities for innovation, AI, automation, advanced analytics, and operational improvement.
* Align technology investments with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
* Help shape and execute digital transformation initiatives that improve productivity, decision\-making, and operational efficiency.


**Technology \& Applications Leadership**
* Lead delivery, support, enhancement, integration, and modernization of enterprise applications.
* Provide leadership for business\-critical systems supporting Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, and Operations, including SAP, Blue Yonder/JDA, and related platforms.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities.
* Ensure application reliability, scalability, security, and alignment with evolving business needs.


**Organization \& Talent Development**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing organization of 50\+ IT professionals across multiple locations.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, coach, mentor, and retain top talent while building a strong leadership pipeline and succession plans.
* Successfully lead through both direct and matrixed organizational structures, driving results through influence and collaboration.


**Operational Excellence \& Governance**
* Establish performance metrics, operational dashboards, and governance mechanisms to drive delivery excellence.
* Champion continuous improvement through disciplined program, project, and portfolio management practices.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, cybersecurity requirements, privacy policies, and risk management processes.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships, budgets, and stakeholder expectations.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of progressive IT leadership experience.
* Significant experience supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain organizations within the semiconductor, high\-tech manufacturing, or related industries.
* Preferred experience with enterprise applications such as SAP, Blue Yonder/JDA, and related business systems.
* Proven success leading business transformation, application modernization, and enterprise technology initiatives.
* Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, automation, and advanced analytics to deliver measurable business value and operational improvements.


**Leadership \& Professional Skills**
* Exceptional leadership, communication, interpersonal, and relationship\-building skills.

* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across diverse organizations.
* Proven ability to develop talent, build organizational capability, and foster high\-performance teams.
* Strategic thinker with a strong execution mindset and passion for continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can be applied to solve business challenges and improve operational effectiveness.

**Position Overview:**
 The Operations Executive / Senior Operations Executive – Fleet Operations (Surface) is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day management of regional fleet operations by ensuring vehicle availability, network connectivity and efficient execution of surface transportation across the assigned region. The role coordinates closely with hubs, service centres, transport vendors and linehaul teams to ensure reliable fleet deployment, schedule adherence and operational continuity.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regional Fleet Manager, the incumbent monitors fleet utilisation, vehicle performance, route execution and operational compliance while supporting cost optimisation and service quality initiatives. The role plays a key part in ensuring timely movement of shipments across the surface network through effective fleet planning, vendor coordination and operational governance.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To support regional fleet operations by ensuring optimum vehicle availability, efficient fleet utilisation, timely execution of linehaul schedules and compliance with operational standards, while driving service reliability, productivity and cost\-effective transportation across the assigned region.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Fleet Operations Management**
* Support the day\-to\-day execution of regional fleet operations across hubs, branches and service centres.
* Coordinate vehicle deployment to ensure uninterrupted movement of shipments across the surface network.
* Monitor fleet availability and utilisation to support daily operational requirements.
* Ensure adherence to planned transportation schedules and operational commitments.
* Support the Regional Fleet Manager in achieving fleet performance, productivity and service objectives.


**Fleet Planning \& Network Coordination**
* Coordinate vehicle placement and movement in line with scheduled milk runs, feeder routes and linehaul operations.
* Monitor route adherence, dispatch schedules and turnaround times to ensure timely network connectivity.
* Coordinate with Hub Managers, Branch Operations and Network Operations teams to optimise fleet deployment.
* Support contingency planning during network disruptions, seasonal peaks and operational emergencies.
* Monitor capacity utilisation and recommend improvements to optimise fleet efficiency.


**Transport Vendor Management**
* Coordinate with transport vendors to ensure timely availability of vehicles as per operational requirements.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels, schedules and operational commitments.
* Support onboarding, documentation and compliance of transport vendors in line with organisational requirements.
* Ensure timely communication with vendors regarding operational changes, route requirements and service expectations.
* Escalate vendor performance issues and support implementation of corrective actions.


**Fleet Performance \& Operational Control**
* Monitor fleet utilisation, vehicle turnaround times and transportation performance across the assigned region.
* Track delays, vehicle breakdowns, route deviations and service disruptions, ensuring timely resolution.
* Coordinate with operational teams to minimise transportation delays and improve network reliability.
* Ensure timely updates of fleet movement and transportation status within operational systems.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving fleet productivity, route efficiency and transportation costs.


**Fleet Compliance \& Operational Governance**
* Ensure fleet operations comply with organisational policies, transportation SOPs and statutory regulations.
* Monitor validity of vehicle documentation, permits, insurance, fitness certificates and statutory compliance in coordination with transport vendors.
* Support implementation of road safety initiatives and fleet governance standards across the assigned region.
* Ensure operational documentation and transportation records are maintained accurately and updated in a timely manner.
* Escalate operational risks, compliance deviations and service issues to the Regional Fleet Manager.


**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**
* Monitor transportation service performance against defined operational KPIs and service level agreements.
* Analyse transportation delays, route deviations, transit exceptions and operational bottlenecks, recommending corrective actions.
* Support implementation of process improvements to enhance fleet productivity, vehicle utilisation and network efficiency.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to improve shipment movement, transit reliability and customer service performance.
* Drive adherence to operational best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across the regional fleet network.


**MIS, Reporting \& Performance Monitoring**
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly fleet performance reports for the assigned region.
* Monitor fleet utilisation, route productivity, vehicle turnaround time, transportation costs and service performance metrics.
* Analyse operational trends and provide insights to improve fleet planning and transportation efficiency.
* Maintain accurate operational dashboards and fleet\-related MIS to support management decision\-making.
* Support periodic reviews of fleet performance, vendor productivity and operational effectiveness.


**Cross\-functional Coordination**
* Collaborate with Regional Operations, Hub Managers, Branch Operations, Network Operations and Procurement teams to ensure seamless fleet execution.
* Coordinate with Security and Safety teams to ensure adherence to transportation safety standards.
* Support implementation of new transportation initiatives, network changes and fleet optimisation projects.
* Participate in operational reviews and contribute towards improving regional transportation performance.
* Foster strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to ensure uninterrupted operational support.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**

title: Project Manager
description:
**Role Description** 




 The Project Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gandhinagar, responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end delivery of client project. This role includes planning project scope, timelines, and resources, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and ensuring milestones are met within budget and quality expectations.
 



  





 The Project Manager will manage stakeholder communication, track risks and dependencies, and facilitate alignment between product, engineering, and client teams. Day\-to\-day tasks involve maintaining project documentation, monitoring progress, driving issue resolution, and ensuring smooth logistics and expediting activities for project deliverables. The role also requires continuous improvement of project processes, support for inspections and quality checks, and proactive reporting on project status to leadership and clients.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong project management skills, including Project Management, planning, scheduling, and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience in expediting and related activities, such as Expeditor responsibilities and Expediting to ensure on\-time delivery of tasks and materials.
* Knowledge of Inspection processes to support quality assurance and compliance across project deliverables.
* Ability to handle Logistics Management, coordinating resources, timelines, and dependencies for smooth project execution.
* Prior experience managing technology or software development projects, ideally in AI, SaaS, or product engineering environments.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, risk management, and decision\-making abilities in fast\-paced, deadline\-driven settings.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are an advantage.
